# laravelforge_worker (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge worker (server background process) by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the worker (background process).
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the worker runs on.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Command the worker runs.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `directory` (String) Working directory of the worker.
- `processes` (Number) Number of processes the worker runs.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `user` (String) System user the worker runs as.
